deals.title: Score and deals
deals.description: What draws attention on the card: the deal that went cold and each contact's score.
deals.rotting: A deal goes cold after how many days?
deals.rottingHint: Time stuck in the same stage, with the deal still open. Empty: never goes cold.
deals.wholeDays: Use a whole number of days.
deals.scoreHint: A number field from this board. The card shows a badge with the range it falls into.
deals.scoreNoFields: Create a number field under Fields to use the score.
deals.scoreOrder: Must be higher than the cold limit.
deals.scorePreview: Below {{low}}: cold. From {{low}} to {{high}}: warm. Above {{high}}: hot.
deals.descriptionScore: What draws attention on the card: each contact's score.

visibility.title: Who sees the cards
visibility.description: Applies to the board, the list, the metrics and the triggers. The organization owner always sees everything.
visibility.modeAllHint: Anyone with access to pipelines sees the whole board.
visibility.modeAssigned: Each person sees only their own cards
visibility.modeAssignedHint: Only the groups allowed below keep seeing everything.
visibility.rolesHint: Include your own group: only people who see all cards can change this rule.
visibility.unassignedNotice: Cards with no owner show up only for the allowed groups. A restricted person becomes the owner of any card they create without assigning.
visibility.noRolesLeft: The last allowed group was deleted. The board stays restricted, and only the organization owner sees everything. Choose a group to let other people in.
visibility.restrictedViewer: On this board, you see only the cards assigned to you. Only people who see all cards can change this rule.
visibility.needsSettings: To change this rule you need access to the organization settings, which is where groups live.

archive.title: Auto-archive
archive.description: What leaves the board on its own. Nothing is deleted: it goes to Archived and can be restored.
archive.staleLabel: Archive a card idle for how many days?
archive.staleHint: Counted from the last change on the card. Empty: never archives on its own.
archive.stalePreview_one: Today, {{count}} card would match this rule and be archived on the next sweep.
archive.stalePreview_other: Today, {{count}} cards would match this rule and be archived on the next sweep.
archive.daysRange: Use a whole number from 1 to {{max}}.
archive.dealLabel: When a deal is marked as won or lost

manual.label: Keep it on the board
manual.hint: The card stays visible until someone archives it.

immediate.label: Archive right away
immediate.hint: The card leaves the board as soon as the deal closes.

auto_archive_days.label: Archive after a few days
auto_archive_days.hint: The card stays visible for a while and then leaves on its own.

danger.title: Taking the board away
danger.description: Archiving can be undone. Deleting can't.
danger.archiveHint: It leaves the menu and stops running triggers. Nothing is lost.
danger.archiveDescription: The board leaves the menu and triggers stop running. Cards stay stored, and you can unarchive it at any time.
danger.unarchiveHint: The board returns to the menu, with everything as it was.
danger.deleteHint: Takes stages, cards, triggers, goals and filters with it. There is no way back.
danger.deleteDescription: This also removes {{stages}}, {{cards}}, the triggers, the goals and the saved filters. There is no way back.

stages.title: Stages
stages.description: The path a card takes. Drag to change the order.
stages.createDescription: Once created, you can set up its checklist.

empty.title: This board has no stages yet
empty.description: Stages are the steps of the work: for example, New, In progress and Done.

row.sla_other: up to {{count}} hours in the stage

fields.name: Name
fields.slaHours: Maximum time in the stage, in hours

fields.wipLimitHint: Just a warning on the board: the stage doesn't refuse cards beyond this.
fields.wholeNumber: Use a whole number above zero.

delete.impactMoving_other: {{count}} triggers that move cards here will start to fail.

checklist.hint: What must be checked for the card to move forward. Moving back requires nothing.

stageFields.title: Fields for this stage
stageFields.hint: They show on the card only while it is here.

fields.description: What each card on this board stores beyond the basics. Drag to change the order.

empty.title: No custom fields

reopen.title: Reopen the deal {{title}}?

delete.description: The card is gone for good, with comments, attachments and history. There is no way back.

bulk.restored_one: {{count}} card is back on the board.
bulk.restored_other: {{count}} cards are back on the board.

template.noTemplates: This channel has no templates yet.

history.codeNotice: A trigger with code shows up twice: once when it enters the queue, once with the result. If the second never arrives, the scripts process is stopped.

noResults.title: No runs with these filters
noResults.description: Change the filters to see the others.

code.footerHint: The code goes with the trigger when you save it.

rules.noRetry: If it fails, it doesn't try again: the error goes to the history and becomes an alert in the menu.
rules.noChain: What the script changes on the card doesn't fire another trigger.
rules.noTimers: No setTimeout, setInterval or external libraries.
rules.names: In the API, a stage is a column and a chat is a conversation: the names are a contract for script writers.

snippets.score: Add points to the score field

board.column: A stage, by ID or name.
board.createCard: Creates a card in a stage.

contact.assignUserByEmail: Assigns the conversation. An unknown email removes the owner.

network.fetch: Calls an external system. 4xx and 5xx don't reject: they come with ok: false.
network.collection: Stores data in the organization's tables.
network.console: Writes to the log, for investigating.

code.noPermission: This trigger runs code. Only people with access to flows can see and change it: the script runs as the whole organization.
code.useLargerScreen: To write code, use a larger screen. Here you can only read it.
